stages.title: Stage 1: Village Street Stall 🟢
stages.subtitle: Learn the basics from Dasan Ashaan

character.name: Dasan Ashaan
character.dialogue: Hello Mr. Perera! Pavanayi Shavamayi, but your roti shouldn't be shavamayi! Roll me a classic round Phulka fast!

comments.start: Ahaa! Show me your Belan magic, apprentice!
comments.good: Bhaashaa! Looking round and smooth like a full moon!
comments.bad: Ayyeyyo! What is this shape? Looks like a flat potato!
comments.timeLow: Vegam, vegam! Time is running out!

character.name: Manar Mathai
character.dialogue: Hello Urvashi Theatres! Urvashi needs an oval Bhatura for her lunch box right now!

comments.start: Hello! Make it nice and oval for Urvashi!
comments.good: Wonderful! That oval curve is perfect!
comments.bad: Enthutukatha idhu! That looks like a broken egg!
comments.timeLow: Fast! Phone is ringing for lunch delivery!

character.name: Anjooran
character.dialogue: No women allowed in my kitchen, and NO ROUND ROTIS! Roll me a strictly 4-cornered square paratha!

comments.good: Good sharp corners! Anjooran is pleased!
comments.bad: Curved edges?! Did I ask for a round roti?!
comments.timeLow: Hurry up before Anjooran gets furious!

character.name: Mangalassery Neelakandan
character.dialogue: Mundakkal Shekaran thinks he can cook? Show him Neelakandan's sharp 3-cornered triangle naan!

comments.start: Show Mundakkal Shekaran what Neelakandan can do!
comments.good: Ha! Sharp 3 corners like a royal sword!
comments.bad: This soft blob won't scare Shekaran!
comments.timeLow: Clock is ticking, finish the triangle!

stages.title: Stage 3: Royal Palace Banquet 🔴
stages.subtitle: Prepare exquisite shapes for royal guests

character.name: Nagavalli
character.dialogue: Vidhyaaa! Give Nagavalli a romantic Heart Roti or she will dance her furious Anklet dance!

comments.bad: Is this a heart or a squashed coconut?! Nagavalli will wake up!
comments.timeLow: The anklet bells are starting to chime! Fast!
idle: Two top lobes, one bottom point!

character.name: Dr. Sunny Joseph
character.dialogue: Unni, this is pure psychology! A crescent moon naan calms Nagavalli's mind instantly!

comments.start: Pure scientific psychology! Roll the crescent moon!
comments.good: Excellent therapy! The curve is scientifically accurate!
comments.bad: My diagnosis: This shape is completely unhinged!

character.name: Sethumadhavan
character.dialogue: Kireedam is not just a crown, it's a 5-pointed star! Roll me a royal star flatbread!

comments.start: Crown the king with a 5-pointed star!
comments.good: 5 shining points! Worthy of the crown!
comments.bad: This is a tragedy... Where are the 5 star points?!
comments.timeLow: Fate is calling, finish the star fast!

character.name: Pavanayi
character.dialogue: Pavanayi ready! Match my secret shape or Pavanayi will finish your roti career forever!

comments.start: Pavanayi ready! Let's see your weapons!
comments.good: Impossible... You matched Pavanayi's secret design!
comments.bad: Pavanayi shavamayi? No! Your roti is shavamayi!
idle: Pavanayi is watching your every move!
